title: Phoenix Education Partners to Acquire Fuel50, Advancing the Future of Workforce Transformation
summary: PHOENIX, September 17, 2026--Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. ("Phoenix Education" or the "Company") (NYSE: PXED) today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Fuel50, Inc., an AI-powered workforce transformation platform.

title: University of Phoenix Announces Collaboration with OpenAI to Advance AI-Powered Learning, Workforce Innovation and Research
summary: PHOENIX, July 14, 2026--Artificial intelligence is transforming nearly every profession, creating a vital need for working adults to continuously develop new skills while they are already in the workforce. Recognizing this challenge, University of Phoenix today announced a collaboration with OpenAI designed to help working adult learners build the AI capabilities they need to succeed in a rapidly changing economy.

title: Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Results
summary: PHOENIX, July 14, 2026--Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. (NYSE: PXED) (the "Company" or "Phoenix Education Partners"), the parent company of The University of Phoenix, Inc. (the "University"), today reported financial results for the three months ended May 31, 2026, with third quarter net revenue of $271.8 million.

title: Phoenix Education Partners Schedules Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
summary: PHOENIX, June 30, 2026--Phoenix Education Partners, Inc. (NYSE: PXED), the parent company of University of Phoenix, today announced it will host a conference call on Tuesday, July 14, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. MST (5:00 p.m. EDT) to discuss its results for third quarter ended May 31, 2026. Financial results will be released the same day after the markets close.
